data: For fiscal 2024, the year ended September 28, 2024, Apple reported net sales of $391.0 billion ($391,035 million), up about 2.0% from $383.3 billion in fiscal 2023. Net income was $93.7 billion ($93,736 million), down about 3.4% from $97.0 billion in fiscal 2023, or $6.08 per diluted share. The decline came despite higher operating income of $123.2 billion, because the provision for income taxes rose to $29.7 billion from $16.7 billion. Total assets at September 28, 2024 were $365.0 billion ($364,980 million), up from $352.6 billion a year earlier. These figures come from the fiscal 2024 Form 10-K filed November 1, 2024 (accession 0000320193-24-000123).
